item.description:
This folder includes user authentication APIs. It provides endpoints for:

Registering new users with role selection (Admin, Adopter, Distributor, Veterinarian, and Daycare).

Logging in with credentials to receive an authentication token.

These endpoints are foundational for secure access and token-based authentication throughout the system. Used as part of all login-protected actions across the app.

item.description:
This folder includes user-facing booking endpoints that allow:

Sending adoption requests for pets.

Booking veterinary appointments.

Making daycare bookings.

Each adoption request is initiated by the adopter and recorded with a Pending status. The request will then be handled by the respective user(Distributor).

Each vet and daycare booking is initiated by the distributor and recorded with a Pending status. The request will then be handled by the respective user(Vet, Daycare).

These APIs support testing of request submission flows and validation handling.

item.description:
Contains APIs designed for admin-level control over all users and entities in the system. The admin can:

View, update, and delete user records for Adopters, Distributors, Veterinarians, Pets, and Daycares.

Search for specific records using filters.

These endpoints simulate real-world admin dashboards and allow testing of centralized user and entity management. Admin actions are typically restricted and require valid authentication tokens.

item.description:
Handles APIs related to daycare management. This includes:

Creating and updating daycare profiles.

Tracking and managing daycare booking requests made by users.

Approving or rejecting daycare bookings, with appropriate status updates.

These APIs reflect real operations in pet care services and test multi-user interactions between daycare managers and pet owners.

These APIs test how distributors interact with adopters, veterinarians, and daycare services — simulating the full distributor workflow.

item.description:
Includes veterinarian profile and operations APIs. The vet can:

Register and manage personal details (clinic, specialization, contact).

View and manage vet appointment requests.

Approve or reject incoming appointments.

Handle health card management and vaccine-related updates for pets.

These endpoints reflect healthcare operations in a veterinary setting and support scenarios involving health record verification.
